Aalborg Universitetshospital is a major hospital located in [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] [^src3]. It is a key institution evaluated in the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) annual reports, which monitor clinical quality indicators for atrial fibrillation treatment across the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. The hospital's organizational structure includes subordinate departments, such as [[aalborg-universitetshospital-thisted|Aalborg Universitetshospital Thisted]] [^src3].

During the reporting period from July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, Aalborg Universitetshospital was assessed on multiple clinical quality indicators. For Indikator 1, which measures the waiting time for anticoagulation treatment, the hospital achieved a compliance rate of 93.6%, successfully meeting the standard [^src1]. However, for [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]], which tracks the performance of echocardiography in newly diagnosed patients, the hospital's compliance was 74.9% (95% CI: 72.1–77.6), indicating room for improvement against the national standard [^src2]. 

The hospital demonstrated strong performance in anticoagulation treatment coverage over time. For [[indikator-4a|Indikator 4a]], 91.1% (95% CI: 87.9–93.6) of patients received appropriate treatment initially [^src3]. This high level of treatment coverage was sustained long-term, with 92.0% compliance two years after diagnosis [^src4] and 91.7% compliance five years after diagnosis [^src5]. 

Furthermore, the hospital is monitored for severe complications and comorbidities. Within one year of diagnosis, the incidence of ischemic stroke (Indikator 15) among the hospital's patients was recorded at 1.8% (95% CI: 1.2–2.8) [^src6]. The hospital also tracks the occurrence of heart failure following an atrial fibrillation diagnosis, which was observed in 5.5% (95% CI: 4.2–6.9) of cases [^src7]. These detailed metrics underscore Aalborg Universitetshospital's integral role in the systematic benchmarking and quality development of cardiovascular care in Denmark [^src7].
